name: Trance-Pinball-Collection
description: Trance Pinball Collection for PC and PSVita
long_description: Runs the original JARs without Java: it includes a small JVM written in C and reimplements the mobile phone APIs. Each game's profile (screen, font, encoding, patches) is selected automatically from the JAR's MIDlet class (or, for i‑mode games, from the `AppClass` in the `.jam` file alongside the `.jar`).
